units.displayText: The Dolls are all gathered in the Ops Room, an uncommon sight, to be sure, and all these familiar faces gathered together make the originally spacious Ops Room suddenly seem a little claustrophobic.

spans.text: The Dolls are all gathered in the Ops Room, an uncommon sight, to be sure, and all these familiar faces gathered together make the originally spacious Ops Room suddenly seem a little claustrophobic.

units.rawText: Teehee, surprised?
units.displayText: Teehee, surprised?

spans.text: Teehee, surprised?

units.rawText: Ah, yes! Everyone, move aside, don't block the decorations! A lot of effort went into them!
units.displayText: Ah, yes! Everyone, move aside, don't block the decorations! A lot of effort went into them!

spans.text: Ah, yes! Everyone, move aside, don't block the decorations! A lot of effort went into them!

units.rawText: The wall is covered in photographs of people, things and landscapes. As I glance at them, I clearly remember all the precious moments they represent.
units.displayText: The wall is covered in photographs of people, things and landscapes. As I glance at them, I clearly remember all the precious moments they represent.

spans.text: The wall is covered in photographs of people, things and landscapes. As I glance at them, I clearly remember all the precious moments they represent.

units.rawText: These are...
units.displayText: These are...

spans.text: These are...

units.rawText: There's combat footage from when I first arrived in the cloud server and memorial pictures of heading out to explore other Sectors.
units.displayText: There's combat footage from when I first arrived in the cloud server and memorial pictures of heading out to explore other Sectors.

spans.text: There's combat footage from when I first arrived in the cloud server and memorial pictures of heading out to explore other Sectors.

units.rawText: There are strange group shots of everyday life in the Oasis and formal pictures bearing witness to official occasions.
units.displayText: There are strange group shots of everyday life in the Oasis and formal pictures bearing witness to official occasions.

spans.text: There are strange group shots of everyday life in the Oasis and formal pictures bearing witness to official occasions.

units.rawText: The memories and Dolls there have shaped the Oasis for the past half a year.
units.displayText: The memories and Dolls there have shaped the Oasis for the past half a year.

spans.text: The memories and Dolls there have shaped the Oasis for the past half a year.

units.rawText: Someone chuckles quietly from behind me. I turn and see Persicaria there, smiling at me.
units.displayText: Someone chuckles quietly from behind me. I turn and see Persicaria there, smiling at me.

spans.text: Someone chuckles quietly from behind me. I turn and see Persicaria there, smiling at me.

units.rawText: Although you probably guessed what was going on... Everyone was still eager to set it all up.
units.displayText: Although you probably guessed what was going on... Everyone was still eager to set it all up.

spans.text: Although you probably guessed what was going on... Everyone was still eager to set it all up.

units.rawText: Happy half anniversary, Professor.
units.displayText: Happy half anniversary, Professor.

spans.text: Happy half anniversary, Professor.

units.rawText: Suddenly waves of cheering and applause wash over me, as though someone had flipped a switch.
units.displayText: Suddenly waves of cheering and applause wash over me, as though someone had flipped a switch.

spans.text: Suddenly waves of cheering and applause wash over me, as though someone had flipped a switch.

units.rawText: Happy half anniversary!
units.displayText: Happy half anniversary!

spans.text: Happy half anniversary!

units.rawText: Cheers and Dolls assault me, and soon I am drowned in a sea of gifts and hugs.
units.displayText: Cheers and Dolls assault me, and soon I am drowned in a sea of gifts and hugs.

spans.text: Cheers and Dolls assault me, and soon I am drowned in a sea of gifts and hugs.

units.rawText: Ehehe, I've been waiting a long time for this day. Now I can lay my hands on you as I wish.
units.displayText: Ehehe, I've been waiting a long time for this day. Now I can lay my hands on you as I wish.

spans.text: Ehehe, I've been waiting a long time for this day. Now I can lay my hands on you as I wish.

units.rawText: I suppose you can spend all day enjoying the vintage wine I prepared for you.
units.displayText: I suppose you can spend all day enjoying the vintage wine I prepared for you.

spans.text: I suppose you can spend all day enjoying the vintage wine I prepared for you.

units.rawText: Do you need an extraction, Professor?
units.displayText: Do you need an extraction, Professor?

spans.text: Do you need an extraction, Professor?

units.rawText: Don't... Don't worry, Professor! I have replacements for your bone structure ready.
units.displayText: Don't... Don't worry, Professor! I have replacements for your bone structure ready.

spans.text: Don't... Don't worry, Professor! I have replacements for your bone structure ready.

units.rawText: Wait—Help...
units.displayText: Wait—Help...

spans.text: Wait—Help...

units.rawText: Before I am completely plunged into darkness, I see Willow's smiling face through a gap in the crowd.
units.displayText: Before I am completely plunged into darkness, I see Willow's smiling face through a gap in the crowd.

spans.text: Before I am completely plunged into darkness, I see Willow's smiling face through a gap in the crowd.

units.rawText: Hehe, that's the picture I was missing.
units.displayText: Hehe, that's the picture I was missing.

spans.text: Hehe, that's the picture I was missing.

units.rawText: Happy half anniversary, Professor!
units.displayText: Happy half anniversary, Professor!

spans.text: Happy half anniversary, Professor!

units.rawText: The wild ride is over at last.
units.displayText: The wild ride is over at last.

spans.text: The wild ride is over at last.

units.rawText: After much resistance and messy merriment, the Dolls clear up their memorabilia and begin returning to their posts. I sit back down in my chair and prepare to exhale heavily—
units.displayText: After much resistance and messy merriment, the Dolls clear up their memorabilia and begin returning to their posts. I sit back down in my chair and prepare to exhale heavily—

spans.text: After much resistance and messy merriment, the Dolls clear up their memorabilia and begin returning to their posts. I sit back down in my chair and prepare to exhale heavily—

units.rawText: Kaclick!
units.displayText: Kaclick!

spans.text: Kaclick!

units.rawText: ...Was that a shutter?
units.displayText: ...Was that a shutter?

spans.text: ...Was that a shutter?

units.rawText: Hehehe~ It's me!
units.displayText: Hehehe~ It's me!

spans.text: Hehehe~ It's me!

units.rawText: Looks like you haven't realized what's happening on the forums yet, have you, Professor?
units.displayText: Looks like you haven't realized what's happening on the forums yet, have you, Professor?

spans.text: Looks like you haven't realized what's happening on the forums yet, have you, Professor?

units.rawText: You were dragging me around all day, I didn't have any time to check them...
units.displayText: You were dragging me around all day, I didn't have any time to check them...

spans.text: You were dragging me around all day, I didn't have any time to check them...

units.rawText: I suddenly have a bad feeling about this. I open it, and the list of recent posts has been secretly filled up—
units.displayText: I suddenly have a bad feeling about this. I open it, and the list of recent posts has been secretly filled up—

spans.text: I suddenly have a bad feeling about this. I open it, and the list of recent posts has been secretly filled up—

units.rawText: ...With emojis of myself.
units.displayText: ...With emojis of myself.

spans.text: ...With emojis of myself.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, I guess it's really hard for you to notice when someone doesn't point it out!
units.displayText: Hahahaha, I guess it's really hard for you to notice when someone doesn't point it out!

spans.text: Hahahaha, I guess it's really hard for you to notice when someone doesn't point it out!

units.rawText: These emojis are all over the place... You weren't the only one making them, were you?
units.displayText: These emojis are all over the place... You weren't the only one making them, were you?

spans.text: These emojis are all over the place... You weren't the only one making them, were you?

units.rawText: Of course not; MINE are reserved for the news page... Ahem. In any case, the emojis circulating around the forums are all thanks to everyone's hard work!
units.displayText: Of course not; MINE are reserved for the news page... Ahem. In any case, the emojis circulating around the forums are all thanks to everyone's hard work!

spans.text: Of course not; MINE are reserved for the news page... Ahem. In any case, the emojis circulating around the forums are all thanks to everyone's hard work!

units.rawText: In that case, why not launch a counterattack? Make emojis of everyone and post them to the forums—
units.displayText: In that case, why not launch a counterattack? Make emojis of everyone and post them to the forums—

spans.text: In that case, why not launch a counterattack? Make emojis of everyone and post them to the forums—
Of course.
But I refuse.

units.rawText: Hehehe, I just knew you'd say yes!
units.displayText: Hehehe, I just knew you'd say yes!

spans.text: Hehehe, I just knew you'd say yes!

units.rawText: Think of it as getting back at them and also winning the prize for the message board event.
units.displayText: Think of it as getting back at them and also winning the prize for the message board event.

spans.text: Think of it as getting back at them and also winning the prize for the message board event.

units.rawText: Aw, don't be in such a hurry to say no, I've got something to sweeten the pot — If anything you make becomes popular, you get the prize for the message board event!
units.displayText: Aw, don't be in such a hurry to say no, I've got something to sweeten the pot — If anything you make becomes popular, you get the prize for the message board event!

spans.text: Aw, don't be in such a hurry to say no, I've got something to sweeten the pot — If anything you make becomes popular, you get the prize for the message board event!

units.rawText: So, how about it, Professor? Feel motivated yet?
units.displayText: So, how about it, Professor? Feel motivated yet?

spans.text: So, how about it, Professor? Feel motivated yet?

units.rawText: I'll need to take a look at the event rules first.
units.displayText: I'll need to take a look at the event rules first.

spans.text: I'll need to take a look at the event rules first.

units.rawText: Hehe, of course!
units.displayText: Hehe, of course!

spans.text: Hehe, of course!

units.rawText: Come, stoke the flames of war and claim the Oasis' headlines!
units.displayText: Come, stoke the flames of war and claim the Oasis' headlines!

spans.text: Come, stoke the flames of war and claim the Oasis' headlines!

units.rawText: What was the situation like on your end? Tell me and I'll make sure to record it all down...
units.displayText: What was the situation like on your end? Tell me and I'll make sure to record it all down...

spans.text: What was the situation like on your end? Tell me and I'll make sure to record it all down...

units.rawText: We managed to rescue two thirds of the Dolls in the Outer Ring. They're currently retreating to the Headquarters.
units.displayText: We managed to rescue two thirds of the Dolls in the Outer Ring. They're currently retreating to the Headquarters.

spans.text: We managed to rescue two thirds of the Dolls in the Outer Ring. They're currently retreating to the Headquarters.

units.rawText: Persicaria looks around the Outer Ring of the Oasis. Their former home is now scarred by the flames of war, and endless hordes of Sanctifiers draw ever closer.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks around the Outer Ring of the Oasis. Their former home is now scarred by the flames of war, and endless hordes of Sanctifiers draw ever closer.
